points.description: Hydrolysis named as one of the steps (breakdown of complex organics into simpler soluble compounds).
Acidogenesis named as one of the steps (acid formation / fermentation to volatile fatty acids; 'acid formation' accepted as a synonym).
Methanogenesis named as one of the steps (methane formation / methane production accepted as a synonym).

rubric.notes: One point per correct step, shared equally; order does not matter and clear synonyms (e.g. acid formation, methane formation) are accepted. Total mark is the sum of the points, rounded to 0, 1 or 2 (about 3 correct = 2, 1–2 correct = 1, none = 0). A wrong extra step, such as acetogenesis, does not cancel the correct ones.
